notice.title: Important Safety Notice
notice.body: Improper installation, use, or maintenance may cause serious damage to the wheels and pose a danger to the rider. To ensure a reliable riding experience, please read and follow the instructions below.
notice.experienceNote: Even if you have years of cycling or wheelset assembly experience, these instructions still apply to these carbon fiber products.

professional.title: Professional installation
professional.body: Have the wheelset installed by a qualified mechanic. Incompatibility with brakes or drivetrain can damage wheels or frame.

tire.title: Tire installation
tire.body: Use provided plastic tire levers only. Metal levers will permanently damage the rim.

torque.title: Torque specs
torque.body: Follow manufacturer recommended torque for all bolts and axles.

brakePads.title: Brake pads
brakePads.body: Use carbon-specific pads only to prevent rim damage.

weight.title: Weight limits
weight.body: Strictly follow max rider weight/load limits. Overloading causes rim cracking and injury risk.

road.title: Road conditions
road.body: Avoid severe potholes and gravel. Impact damage may not be immediately visible.
road.note: After impact: clean the rim, remove the tire, and inspect carefully.

braking.title: Braking technique
braking.body: Avoid continuous drag braking on long descents. Use intermittent braking to prevent carbon overheating.

inspection.title: Pre-ride inspection
items: Check rims for cracks, bulges, or delamination.
Inspect brake pads and remove metal shavings or stones.

tension.title: Spoke tension
tension.body: Regularly check for even tension distribution.

cleaning.title: Cleaning
cleaning.body: Use neutral detergent and soft cloth only. Do not use strong acids, alkalis, or high-pressure water.

prohibited.title: Strictly prohibited
items: No sanding or grinding with metal tools.
No extreme-temperature storage such as ovens or freezing environments.

protocol.title: Emergency protocol
protocol.bodyBefore: If cracks or abnormal noises occur:
protocol.bodyAfter: After any crash, perform thorough inspection even if no damage is visible.
